falsifiers.C1-SINGLE-CORPUS: Pattern-scan Vol II chapters 1-166 for any NT, Quran, Second Temple, Qumran, rabbinic, Josephan, patristic, or Shii citation outside Chapter 1, Appendix J, the fenced companion block, and the bibliography absence declaration; one hit falsifies.
falsifiers.C2-WEIGHTS: Recount corpus weight for each volume by named-only, nearest-named, and chapter-dominant instruments; any value outside the printed range in the companion block or README falsifies.
falsifiers.C3-INDEPENDENCE: Ten-gram shingle overlap between any pair of volumes at or above 0.2 percent, or 50 or more identical sentences, falsifies the independence claim.
falsifiers.C4-NAMING: Enumerate every honorific-marked token per volume; any marked name outside the declared list and exceptions, any listed prophet in a competing form, any marked adjective or non-prophet, or any mark in Vol II, falsifies.
falsifiers.C5-STRUCTURE: Count CHAPTER headings and TOC entries; any mismatch with 166/97/104, any duplicate or gap, or any chapter, appendix, or excursus reference with no target, falsifies.
falsifiers.C6-CONVERGENCE: Locate in each volume's own text the four components of the shared finding: unentered terminus, receiver-located deficit, escalation of the figure, passive grammar of receipt; any component absent from a volume or stated only by pointer to another volume falsifies.
falsifiers.C7-FALSIFIERS: For each volume locate the advance statement of falsification criteria and their return; a criterion stated without return or a return without prior statement falsifies.
falsifiers.C8-LINK-ACCURACY: Check every count, DOI, licence, and deposit-state assertion in the companion block and README against the artifacts and the live Zenodo API record; any contradiction falsifies.
